messages:
maria: hey team :wave: opened a tiny PR to clarify eviction semantics when tenant queues back up under Dedicated — probing autoscale cooldown + isolation wording. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1427

maria: specific ask: make the 'preemption vs eviction' paragraph clearer and add a YAML snippet showing the scaledown cooldown + queue_limit behavior. also need a short rationale line for localization (i18n) folks so translators get context.

dan: on it. quick Q — do we want the example to show `burst_capacity` + `queue_limit` or just `cooldown_seconds`?

rachel: recommend both. readers get fewer surprises if they can see the composed policy. short example, not full manifest.

leo: draft snippet attached in the PR comments — copying here for visibility:
```yaml
scale_policy:
  mode: autoscale
  cooldown_seconds: 120
  burst_capacity: 2
  queue_limit: 500
  fallback_policy: "reserved-fallback"
```

leo: note: the important sentence to add below the snippet is: "When queue_limit is exceeded, requests are rejected with 429 and the autoscaler will attempt scale-up; eviction can occur only if a higher-priority tenant requires the node."

maria: that wording is good, can we soften the sentence about eviction to avoid implying immediate eviction? maybe: "eviction may be triggered when higher-priority workload preemption is required."

rachel: yep +1 to softer phrasing. also add an example of the error payload returned to callers so product teams know how to handle retries.

jen: small localization note — please add an English context string for each user-facing sentence that translators will see. e.g., // context: why queue_limit returns 429 (users should back off, not retry aggressively)

maria: added a comment in the PR with suggested i18n context lines.

docs-ci: build check: docs lint passed, linkcheck failed on one internal anchor (line 214) — failing link: #eviction-examples.

maria: thanks docs-ci. i'll fix the anchor and push.

dan: editorial pass volunteer here. i'll tighten passive voice and keep the snippet examples minimal.

leo: one more technical nit: let's ensure the snippet's `fallback_policy` name matches the catalog example in infra (it's `reserved-pool-fallback` there). i'll update to match infra to avoid drift.

maria: perfect. plan: dan will push copy edits, leo will update YAML to match infra, rachel will add error-payload example, jen will provide i18n context strings. i'll squash + merge after CI green. target: EOD tomorrow. :rocket:

rachel: adding the error payload example now:
```json
{
  "error": "tenant_queue_full",
  "status": 429,
  "retry_after_seconds": 30
}
```

maria: lovely. leaving one TODO for infra: confirm `reserved-pool-fallback` semantics with infra oncall. i'll ping infra in #eng-infra after this thread.

dan: thumbs up, will watch the PR. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all — keeping this small so we can ship clarity for teams running Dedicated.
